questions.question: Which of the following is the capital of India?
questions.explanation: New Delhi is the capital of India.

questions.question: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars is called the Red Planet due to iron oxide.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of water?
questions.explanation: H2O consists of hydrogen and oxygen.

questions.question: Who wrote the National Anthem of India?
questions.explanation: Jana Gana Mana was written by Rabindranath Tagore.

questions.question: Which organ in human body filters blood?
questions.explanation: Kidneys remove waste and filter blood.

questions.question: What is the boiling point of water at standard pressure?
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.

questions.question: Who is known as the Father of the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was the chairman of the drafting committee.

questions.question: Which gas is essential for human respiration?
questions.explanation: Oxygen is required for cellular respiration.

questions.question: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of electric current?
questions.explanation: Ampere is the unit of electric current.

questions.question: Which acid is present in lemon?
questions.explanation: Lemons contain citric acid.

questions.question: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
questions.explanation: Mercury is liquid at room temperature.

questions.question: What is the escape velocity from the surface of the Earth approximately?
questions.explanation: The escape velocity from the Earth is approximately 11.2 km/s (around 25,000 mph).

questions.question: Which electromagnetic radiation has the highest frequency in the electromagnetic spectrum?
questions.explanation: Gamma rays have the shortest wavelength and highest frequency in the electromagnetic spectrum.

questions.question: Why do astronauts experience apparent weightlessness inside an orbiting International Space Station (ISS)?

options.A: There is zero gravity in low Earth orbit
options.B: The ISS and astronauts are in continuous free fall towards Earth
options.C: Atmospheric drag balances out gravitational attraction
options.D: Centrifugal force completely neutralizes Earth mass

questions.explanation: Astronauts in orbit are in free-fall around Earth, giving the sensation of weightlessness even though gravity is ~90% of surface gravity.

questions.question: A convex lens with a focal length of 20 cm produces a real image of the same size as the object. Where should the object be placed?
questions.explanation: For a convex lens, a real image of the same size is formed when the object is placed at twice the focal length (2F = 40 cm).

questions.question: Which satellite constellation powers India indigenous regional satellite navigation system NavIC?
questions.explanation: NavIC is powered by the Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System (IRNSS) constellation.

questions.question: What phenomenon explains the blue color of the clear sky during daytime?
questions.explanation: Rayleigh scattering scatters shorter wavelengths (blue/violet) much more strongly than longer wavelengths.

questions.question: If an electric kettle rated 1000 W operates for 30 minutes daily, what is the energy consumed in 30 days in commercial units (kWh)?
questions.explanation: Daily energy = 1 kW * 0.5 h = 0.5 kWh. Over 30 days = 0.5 * 30 = 15 kWh (units).

questions.question: Which of the following describes Bernoulli principle most accurately?

options.A: Viscosity increases with velocity in a moving fluid
options.B: Fluid pressure decreases where fluid speed increases
options.C: Mass cannot be created or destroyed in fluid dynamics
options.D: Buoyancy is equal to fluid displaced

questions.explanation: Bernoulli principle states that an increase in the speed of a fluid occurs simultaneously with a decrease in static pressure.

questions.question: What propulsion fuel combination was used in the cryogenic upper stage of LVM3 (Chandrayaan-3)?
questions.explanation: Cryogenic stages use Liquid Oxygen (LOX) at -183 C and Liquid Hydrogen (LH2) at -253 C.
